name: mirage
text:
I checked what GitHub holds, and none of the BoltOdds keys on it is Growth. BoltOdds' own account endpoint reports the 3 saved keys as: #1 Free, #2 Trial, #3 Trial. So either the Growth key wasn't saved under the BoltOdds secret, or BoltOdds hasn't switched the account's key to Growth yet. If it was just upgraded, check the key shown on your BoltOdds dashboard and send it again from Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys.

What I built so you're ready either way (it's running on the engine now):
1. The engine reads each key's plan and uses the best paid key first, instead of whichever it tried first. It logs 'BoltOdds plans by key' hourly.
2. On a one-connection plan (Growth, Starter, Trial) it now runs a single socket carrying lines and props. Before, the props socket was refused and props went dark. It's live now: lines live, props on the same socket.
3. On a 3-league plan it keeps NCAAF, NBA and NHL (the leagues with the most volume in our data), in that order.
4. Pro behavior is unchanged.

Note the Trial keys have only 300 snapshot tokens a day, and I can't say which 3 leagues a Trial covers. Once the real Growth key is there, the engine picks it up on the next hourly check, or I can restart it.
